title: ISO 230-4:2022 — Circular tests for numerically controlled machine tools
locator: Official catalogue scope for circular and coordinated linear/rotary-axis contouring tests
notes: Method for evaluating contouring performance on coordinated NC axes, including circular/constant-radius paths using combinations of linear and rotary axes. It does not test motor cogging torque, static torque ripple or stand-alone single-axis low-speed servo behavior.
